_comment: Single source of truth for Ulendo package pricing and content. Nothing in the markup should hardcode a price — read it from here so the site and the Figma file never drift apart.
_whatsappNote: International format, digits only, no + or spaces. Matches links.ts's whatsapp.base number.
_travellerPricingNote: Base price is per couple (2 people). Each individual added beyond 2 is charged at half the couple price, less a 10% discount, via count on each option below — not fixed couple multiples.

packages.name: Durban
packages.heroSubtitle: Umhlanga Rocks · 2 nights · Return flights for two

includes.title: Return flights
includes.body: Direct, 1h05m from JHB. Checked bag included.

includes.title: 2 nights, Umhlanga
includes.body: Beachfront room for two, breakfast daily.

includes.title: Airport transfers
includes.body: King Shaka airport to hotel and back.

includes.title: Two experiences
includes.body: Chosen by you from the five below.

stay.heading: Two nights in Umhlanga
stay.body: Umhlanga is Durban's beachfront north of the city: a walkable promenade, the lighthouse, and Indian Ocean water warm enough to swim year-round. The restaurant strip and Gateway are ten minutes inland.

experiences.name: Inanda Heritage Route
experiences.description: Ohlange, the Gandhi settlement and Shembe — the route most visitors never see.

experiences.name: Deep-sea harbour cruise
experiences.description: Out past the harbour mouth with the skyline and the stadium arch behind you.

experiences.name: uShaka Marine World
experiences.description: Aquarium, dolphin stadium and the Wet 'n Wild slides on one ticket.

experiences.name: Valley of a Thousand Hills
experiences.description: Zulu cultural village and the escarpment views inland from the city.

experiences.name: Tala Game Reserve safari
experiences.description: Rhino, giraffe and hippo about an hour from the beach.

originNotes.dur: No flights — stay and experiences only

packages.name: Cape Town
packages.heroSubtitle: Sea Point · 2 nights · Return flights for two

includes.title: Return flights
includes.body: Direct, 2h10m from JHB. Checked bag included.

includes.title: 2 nights, Sea Point
includes.body: City-and-sea room for two, breakfast daily.

includes.title: Airport transfers
includes.body: Cape Town airport to hotel and back.

includes.title: Two experiences
includes.body: Chosen by you from the five below.

stay.heading: Two nights in Sea Point
stay.body: Sea Point puts you on the Atlantic promenade with Signal Hill at your back and the city bowl ten minutes away. Table Mountain, the Waterfront and Camps Bay are all a short drive.

experiences.name: Table Mountain, Penguins & Cape Point
experiences.description: Cableway up the mountain, the Boulders penguins, then the Cape of Good Hope.

experiences.name: Franschhoek Wine Tram
experiences.description: Hop-on hop-off between the valley estates by tram and open-top bus.

experiences.name: Robben Island
experiences.description: Ferry from the Waterfront and a tour led by former political prisoners.

experiences.name: Shark cage diving, Gansbaai
experiences.description: Two hours down the coast to the cage. Not for everyone.

experiences.name: Hop-on hop-off city tour
experiences.description: Open-top bus across the city bowl, Camps Bay and the winelands loop.

packages.name: Zanzibar
packages.heroSubtitle: Kendwa beach · 4 nights · Return flights for two

includes.title: Return flights
includes.body: Direct, 3h35m from JHB. Checked bag included.

includes.title: 4 nights, Kendwa
includes.body: Beachfront room for two, breakfast daily.

includes.title: Airport transfers
includes.body: Zanzibar airport to resort and back.

includes.title: Two experiences
includes.body: Chosen by you from the five below.

stay.heading: Four nights on Kendwa beach
stay.body: Kendwa faces west, so it keeps deep swimmable water through the tide and gets the best sunsets on the island — without the hustle of neighbouring Nungwi. Your room is beachfront with breakfast daily.

experiences.name: Stone Town & Prison Island
experiences.description: UNESCO alleyways, the old slave market, then giant tortoises across the water.

experiences.name: Safari Blue sandbank day
experiences.description: Dhow out to the sandbank, snorkelling, grilled seafood lunch on the sand.

experiences.name: Spice farm tour
experiences.description: Cinnamon, cloves and vanilla straight off the tree, with a farm lunch.

experiences.name: Nakupenda snorkelling
experiences.description: Mnemba reef, then a sandbar that only exists at low tide.

experiences.name: Jozani Forest & The Rock
experiences.description: Red colobus monkeys, then lunch at the restaurant in the sea.

packages.name: Bilene
packages.heroSubtitle: San Martinho Beach Club · 4 nights · Return flights for two

includes.title: Return flights
includes.body: Direct to Maputo, 1h20m from JHB. Checked bag included.

includes.title: 4 nights, Bilene
includes.body: Lagoon-side apartment for two at San Martinho.

includes.title: Road transfers
includes.body: Maputo airport to Bilene and back, about 3h20m each way.

includes.title: Two experiences
includes.body: Chosen by you from the three below.

stay.heading: Four nights on Bilene lagoon
stay.body: San Martinho sits on Mozambique's largest lagoon, held off the ocean by a dune barrier — so the water stays warm, calm and shallow enough to wade a long way out. Self-catering apartments and villas, some with private splash pools.

experiences.name: Lagoon cruise to the sandbar
experiences.description: Boat across the lagoon to the sand spit, with time to swim and snorkel.

experiences.name: Maputo city tour
experiences.description: The Samora Machel statue, the fish market and the Katembe bridge.

experiences.name: Jet ski or quad bikes
experiences.description: Booked at the resort activity desk — lagoon water or dune trails.

packages._note: Only three experiences here — the other two were unverified. Picker still requires exactly two, so the customer chooses two of three.
